IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — Scales in vitro intrinsic clearance (CLint) to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using well-stirred and parallel-tube models.

Input: Compound data CSV containing compound_id, CLint_uL_per_min_mg, and molecular_weight columns for your 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs (e.g., Imatinib, Dasatinib, Nilotinib, Ponatinib)
Key steps:

CLint scaling → microsomal protein binding correction + liver weight/hepatocellularity scaling → intrinsic CLh (mL/min/kg)
Well-stirred model + parallel-tube model → predicted CLh (mL/min/kg) per compound
Extraction ratio (E = CLh / Qh, where Qh = 20.7 mL/min/kg) → hepatic extraction classification (low / intermediate / high)


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh and extraction ratio per compound, both models) + clearance_summary.json (ranked summary with extraction tier flags)


Note: To run this workflow, upload your compound CSV with columns: compound_id, CLint_uL_per_min_mg, and molecular_weight. If you don't have measured CLint values yet, BioMate can first predict microsomal clearance from SMILES using the CYP DDI panel workflow.

IVIVE Hepatic Clearance — BCR-ABL1 TKI Panel — Scales measured microsomal CLint to predicted human hepatic clearance (CLh) and extraction ratio for 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs using the well-stirred liver model.

Input: 4 BCR-ABL1 TKIs with measured CLint and fu_plasma values — Dasatinib (CLint=220 μL/min/mg, fu_plasma=0.04), Bosutinib (CLint=60 μL/min/mg, fu_plasma=0.03), Imatinib (CLint=25 μL/min/mg, fu_plasma=0.04), Nilotinib (CLint=12 μL/min/mg, fu_plasma=0.01); model parameters: Qh=20.7 mL/min/kg, fu_mic=1.0, well-stirred model
Key steps:

CLint scaling → microsomal protein binding correction (fu_mic=1.0) + hepatocellularity scaling → scaled intrinsic CLh per compound
Well-stirred model (CLh = Qh × fu_plasma × CLint_scaled / (Qh + fu_plasma × CLint_scaled)) → predicted CLh (mL/min/kg) per compound
Extraction ratio calculation (E = CLh / Qh = CLh / 20.7) → hepatic extraction tier classification (low E < 0.3 / intermediate 0.3–0.7 / high E > 0.7)


Expected output: ivive_results.csv (CLh mL/min/kg + extraction ratio per compound, well-stirred model) + clearance_summary.json (ranked summary with extraction tier flags per TKI)
